title: Validate imports before durable mutation
description: Parse an untrusted WorkspaceBundle, validate the complete candidate, and present an actionable ImportPlan before any IndexedDB or cache mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: File type, bundle shape, schema versions, counts/sizes, integrity hashes, records, assets, and references are validated before mutation
No durable write or cache change occurs while selecting, parsing, validating, or reviewing a candidate
ImportPlan reports proposed counts, migrations, conflicts, errors, and warnings grouped by affected type/record
Commit remains disabled until the full plan is valid and the user explicitly confirms
Validation is keyboard operable with progress, cancellation, and announced completion/failure

steps.details: Validate file/container type and enforce documented count, byte, nesting, and asset bounds before materializing expensive structures or paths.
Parse schema metadata, run migrations in memory, validate every registered type/hash/reference, and return a serializable ImportPlan without repository writes.
Render semantic headings/lists with affected identities, counts, warnings/errors, progress, safe default cancellation, and explicit commit confirmation.
Snapshot durable state before candidate selection and assert byte/logical equivalence after valid review, invalid input, cancellation, and parser failure.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; implement bounded planning and one pre-commit report path only.
Imported bundles are hostile input: reject executable content, unsafe paths, malformed binaries, and resource-exhaustion shapes.
Planning may transform an in-memory candidate but must not touch durable stores.
